title: IIBF IE&IFS Unit 13: Monetary & Fiscal Policy Frameworks, Deficit Metrics & FRBM
summary: Exhaustive synthesis of RBI Monetary Policy tools (Repo, SDF, MSF, CRR, SLR), MPC composition, Fiscal Deficit formulas, Primary Deficit, FRBM Act benchmarks, and counter-cyclical fiscal policy.

blocks.title: IIBF Core Foundation: Policy Transmission Architecture
blocks.summary: Macroeconomic management rests on the twin pillars of Monetary Policy (RBI controlling money supply, cost of credit, and liquidity) and Fiscal Policy (Ministry of Finance managing revenue mobilization, government expenditure, and public debt).

blocks.text: 🏛️ 1. RBI Monetary Policy Operating Framework (Liquidity Management)

blocks.caption: RBI Monetary Policy Instruments Master Matrix
rows: Rate at which RBI lends short-term liquidity to banks against approved government securities.
**Floor of LAF corridor** (25 bps below Repo). Absorbs surplus liquidity from banks **WITHOUT requiring collateral G-Secs**.
**Ceiling of LAF corridor** (25 bps above Repo)
Overnight liquidity window for banks experiencing severe liquidity mismatch; allows dipping into SLR quota up to specified limit.
Standard rate at which RBI buys or rediscounts bills of exchange; penal rate for CRR/SLR defaults (aligned with MSF rate).
Specified percentage of **Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL)** that banks must maintain as **cash balances with RBI**. Earns **zero interest**.
Specified percentage of NDTL maintained in **unencumbered approved securities (G-Secs, T-Bills), cash, or gold**. Cap: 40%.
RBI buys G-Secs to inject durable liquidity; sells G-Secs to absorb liquidity.

items: **Statutory Basis:** Constituted under **Section 45ZB of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934** (amended in 2016).

**Composition:** Exactly **6 Members**:
  1. **RBI Governor** — Ex-officio Chairperson.
  2. **RBI Deputy Governor in charge of Monetary Policy** — Ex-officio Member.
  3. **One Officer of RBI nominated by Central Board** — Ex-officio Member.
  4. **Three External Experts appointed by Central Government** (Tenure of 4 years; not eligible for re-appointment).
**Quorum & Decision Rule:** Quorum is **4 members** (must include Governor or Deputy Governor). Decisions made by majority vote; **Governor holds a casting vote in case of a tie**.

blocks.caption: Government Deficit Formulas & Economic Meanings
rows: Measures government dissaving; borrowing used purely for day-to-day operational consumption.
**Total borrowing requirement of the government from all sources** in a financial year.
Measures government borrowing requirement excluding the burden of past accumulated debt interest obligations.
$$\text{Revenue Deficit} - \text{Grants for Creation of Capital Assets}$$
Excludes capital asset building grants given to States from revenue deficit.

blocks.content:
🎯 Top IIBF Traps for Unit 13:
1. **SDF Collateral:** Standing Deposit Facility absorbs liquidity **WITHOUT any G-Sec collateral**.
2. **CRR Section vs SLR Section:** CRR is under **Section 42(1) of RBI Act 1934**; SLR is under **Section 24 of Banking Regulation Act 1949**.
3. **Primary Deficit Formula:** **Fiscal Deficit minus Interest Payments**.
4. **MPC Casting Vote:** In the event of a tie (3-3), the **RBI Governor exercises a second / casting vote**.
